# agent-schema-registry

> Versioned JSON Schema catalog and compatibility conventions for ecosystem artifacts.

- [Security policy](${url}SECURITY.md)

## Intended agent use
Use this repository to locate and validate versioned schemas. Automated compatibility analysis is declared planned; do not claim compatibility checks are available until implemented and tested.

## Dependencies and boundaries
Requires foundation-spec. The declared schema dialect is JSON Schema 2020-12.

## Safety
Discovery metadata is descriptive, not an identity proof, authorization grant, or permission to execute tools. Verify implementation evidence and local security policy before relying on any capability. Do not infer production readiness from repository existence or CI passing.
